title: Rithum (ChannelAdvisor) alternatives: how to choose, and why sellers switch to Zentail
summary: Nov 17, 2026 • Comparing Rithum (ChannelAdvisor) alternatives? See what to ask every vendor, why sellers like Sherper's switched to Zentail, and how to plan your move.
body_markdown:
If you're looking for a Rithum alternative, start with how your business sells today, not how it sold when you first signed. ChannelAdvisor is now part of Rithum, so this guide covers both names.


This guide explains how to compare platforms, the four questions to ask every vendor, and why sellers like Sherper's switched to Zentail.


**Want to know why businesses move away from Rithum?**[Read our analysis of 40+ reviews and seller discussions](https://www.zentail.com/blog/we-analyzed-40-reviews-seller-discussions-to-understand-why-sellers-leave-rithum-channeladvisor) to see the most common reasons sellers make the switch.


## Choose software based on your priorities


The right ChannelAdvisor alternative depends on what you're trying to improve. Start by identifying the biggest challenge your team is solving today. Many platforms support more than one of these priorities, but each has its own strengths.


**Growing on marketplaces.** If Amazon, Walmart, Target Plus, and other marketplaces are driving your growth, pay close attention to how each platform manages your catalog. Ask how product data is maintained across channels, how marketplace-specific requirements are handled, and how easy it is to identify listings that aren't live.


**Strengthening inventory and warehouse operations.** If inventory management is your biggest challenge, focus on warehouse capabilities, purchasing, fulfillment, and inventory controls before comparing marketplace features.


**Expanding internationally.** If international growth is part of your roadmap, make sure the platform supports the countries, marketplaces, retailers, and languages you'll need over the next few years, not just the ones you sell through today.


**Managing your ecommerce website.** If your ecommerce website is your primary sales channel, compare how each platform supports your storefront alongside marketplace selling. The right balance depends on where you expect future growth to come from.

## Four questions to ask every vendor


Every software demo should leave you with clear answers to these questions.


### 1. Does it support the marketplaces you want to grow?


Look beyond the logo page. Ask how deeply each marketplace is supported, what listing capabilities are available, and whether the platform supports the workflows your business relies on.


### 2. How much catalog work will your team own?


Ask how product data is managed, how marketplace-specific requirements are handled, and how quickly you can update listings across multiple channels.


### 3. How does the platform keep up with marketplace changes?


Marketplace requirements change regularly. Ask how updates are communicated, how listing requirements stay current, and what your team is expected to do when those changes happen.


### 4. What happens after implementation?


Ask who you'll work with after onboarding, how support requests are handled, and what resources are available as your business grows.

## Frequently asked questions


### Is ChannelAdvisor the same as Rithum?


Yes. CommerceHub and ChannelAdvisor joined forces in 2022 and rebranded as Rithum at the end of 2023.


### What is the best Rithum alternative?


It depends on your goals. Some platforms focus on marketplace selling, while others prioritize inventory management, global commerce, or ecommerce websites. If growing on Amazon, Walmart, Target Plus and other marketplaces is your priority, Zentail is built for that.


### What should I look for when comparing Rithum alternatives?


Start with the areas that have the biggest impact on your business: marketplace support, catalog management, automation, onboarding, ongoing support, and the amount of manual work required to keep listings up to date.


### Why do sellers choose Zentail over Rithum?


In Sherper's words: "The ease of onboarding, the support from the team, and the efficiency of managing our data have been great."
